info.name: DoCoNEXT Finder
info.summary: Find files fast: structured search with filters, saved searches and configurable columns.
info.description:
Finder is a search page for your Nextcloud files, built for people who look things up all day.
- **Structured search** — combine conditions on name, size, created and modified date. Match all of them, or any of them. - **Saved searches** — name a search you run often and get back to it in one click. Recent searches are kept automatically. - **Configurable columns** — choose which columns the result grid shows, in which order, and rename them to your own vocabulary. - **Grouping** — group results by type, folder or date to see the shape of a result set instead of a flat list. - **Favorites** — browse and toggle your favorite files from the same grid.
Everything works on a plain Nextcloud. When the DoCoNEXT Core app is also installed, Finder additionally filters and groups on Core's metadata fields.
